mentions.description: This web app helps users find remixes for their favorite Spotify playlists, surfacing alternate versions, club mixes, and remixed versions to support their playlist curating process.

mentions.name: Remixify
mentions.description: Remixify helps DJs find "play-out" versions of tracks they already like, such as Extended Mixes, Club Edits, or specific remixes, instead of the Radio Edits that streaming services optimize for. Users paste a Spotify playlist URL, the tool automates the search for DJ-usable versions, and results are grouped by original track so users can preview and save the versions they want into a new playlist. It does not recommend new music or use AI to guess taste; it only finds usable versions of music the user already selected.
mentions.problem: Streaming services are optimized for Radio Edits, and manually searching for the "DJ version" of every single track in a 50-song playlist is tedious administrative work that kills the joy of digging.
mentions.audience: DJs who want mixable versions of tracks they already like
mentions.source_excerpt: Remixify automates the search while leaving the selection to you. You paste a Spotify playlist URL, and it helps you or provides you a good starting point for digging. It groups the results by the original track so you can quickly preview and save the versions you want to a new playlist.
